title: Recipe exports
description: What a recipe declares (autoresearch design, everything-ecosystem docs/design/AUTORESEARCH_RECORDS_2026-11-06.md, "The recipe"). A recipe is one pure TypeScript module per projected route pattern, at <pattern>.recipe.ts beside the records it makes (competitors/[id]/signals.recipe.ts makes every competitor's competitors/<id>/signals.json). The file is source, not JSON, so the data model gives the record type the form typescript and this schema governs only the data the module exports, as packages/naive/src/engine/recipes/sandbox.ts recipeExports reads it: hears (the signal type ranges and named facts it reads) and knobs (numbers and short lists a knob search may step). The default export, render(input, knobs) returning { record, receptions }, is checked by the sandbox, not here. Nothing reads recipes from a venture yet: the routes, the gate rule and the pull are later build items.

signals.description: The signal type ranges the recipe hears: every signal of these types about the subject, observed at or before asOf, reaches it, and it returns one reception for each

facts.description: Named facts, each a venture file and optionally one field in it (foundation/icp.json#markets), read as of asOf and passed in under its name

knobs.description: The recipe's tunable values. A knob search (naive recipes search) steps each number, boolean and rating floor; a model edit may add or remove them

knob.description: A number, a short string (a rating floor such as B2), a boolean, or a short list of them
